name: Ricardo Benavides
bio:
Ricardo's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. Fresh out of university with a degree in economics, he took a temporary role at a small racing team near Valencia to gain experience. Initially, he saw it as just another job, but the energy of the paddock and the sheer passion of the team quickly captivated him. He found himself drawn to the financial intricacies of the sport, fascinated by how meticulously budgets were managed and how crucial financial decisions were to on-track performance.

Ricardo brings a methodical and adaptable approach to his role. He's a firm believer in transparency and accuracy, ensuring that every financial decision is grounded in solid data. While still developing his expertise, he is eager to learn and embrace new challenges. His detail-oriented nature and lone wolf tendencies mean he thrives when given complex tasks to solve independently, often finding innovative solutions through meticulous analysis. He hopes to contribute to a team's success by providing a stable financial foundation.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Ricardo is of average height, with a serious, focused expression often accentuated by his thin-rimmed glasses.

quirks: Always carries a small, well-worn notebook filled with financial calculations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when concentrating.
Insists on using a specific brand of calculator, claiming it gives him better results.
